svg.text: DueDilly questionnaire pack · mommy duck = the DDQ, ducklings = its sections
Progress row: one duckling per DDQ section, following mommy
Section 5 has gaps or inconsistent answers
Every section complete, ready to submit
Ugly duckling + "A few answers need another look before you submit." Never call their DDQ ugly.
Ugly duckling label: "Poorly completed", with the list of failed checks per section.
Submit button unlocks. "All 7 sections complete. Ready to submit."
